en: Pixel merge made easy: every format offers 2x2, 3x3 and 6x6, plus 1x2 and 1x3, as RES presets.
2x2, 3x3, 1x2 and 1x3 record 1:1 with RWZM off (centred crop of at most 16 px). 6x6 presets already include the purple-safe margin, so the size you set is the size you record.
The merge hint shows each preset's merge, e.g. “2x2”, or “6x6+RW” where RWZM scales, with the per-axis ratio in the RES small text.
No purple first frame. Old QR codes keep working.
CinemaDNG 8/10-bit; bit depth on the QS FORMAT tile.
Known issue: OG 6x6 (2x2 + ISP 3x3) can place its first frame about 2 rows off.
zh: 像素合併更好用：每個畫幅的 RES 預設都有 2x2、3x3、6x6，以及 1x2、1x3。
2x2、3x3、1x2、1x3 都是 1:1 錄製、RWZM 關閉（置中裁切最多 16 px）。6x6 預設已包含防紫屏餘量，設定的尺寸就是錄出的尺寸。
合併提示顯示每個預設的合併方式（例如「2x2」，用到 RWZM 時為「6x6+RW」），RES 小字顯示各軸比率。
首幀不紫屏。舊 QR 碼可用。
CinemaDNG 8／10-bit，QS FORMAT 格可選位深。
已知問題：OG 6x6（2x2＋ISP 3x3）第一幀可能錯位約 2 列。

en: API 9: fine-tune and sub-QS on one function (needed by Sensor Lab 0.0.2test and later).
On the camera since 2026-11-07, in every Sensor Lab session since.
zh: API 9：細調與子 QS 可在同一功能（Sensor Lab 0.0.2test 起需要）。
2026-11-07 起上機，之後每次 Sensor Lab 上機都用它。

en: Compresses true 14-bit (Sensor Lab 1:1 AD14) as well as 10/12-bit. A take can mix compressed and uncompressed frames.
On the camera (2026-11-10, SD card): 14-bit 1936x1090, 63 of 63 frames compressed, and 6048x4040, 41 of 41; decoded frames match the uncompressed first frame. SSD not tested.
zh: 支援真 14-bit 壓縮（Sensor Lab 1:1 AD14），10／12-bit 照舊。同一段可混合壓縮與未壓縮幀。

en: Andy_hal9000's rear-wheel decoder v6 as a Loader v4 sup. The rear wheel (its switch bounces) moves one step per click, in the right direction; clockwise is +1, and fast spins are counted too.
The decoder is his v6 word for word; it runs from the sup's own memory and the dial's vtable is pointed at it, so no camera code is overwritten. Power off restores the stock decoder.
Firmware 5.02 only. If the dial object is not where 5.02 has it, the sup does nothing.

The decoder was tested on the camera by its author as an AutoRun card (2026-11-07), and this sup form on 2026-11-10: it loads and the wheel steps one click at a time. Restoring the stock decoder at power off has not been checked separately.
zh: Andy_hal9000 的後轉盤解碼器 v6,做成 Loader v4 sup。後轉盤(開關會彈跳)每轉一格只走一步、方向正確；順時針為 +1,快轉也照算。
解碼器與他的 v6 逐字相同，在 sup 自己的記憶體執行，只把轉盤的 vtable 指過去，不覆寫相機程式碼。關機時還原原廠解碼器。
僅限韌體 5.02。轉盤物件不在 5.02 的位置時,sup 什麼都不做。
解碼器本身由作者以 AutoRun 卡上機驗證過(2026-11-07);這個 sup 版 2026-11-10 上機：正常載入、轉盤一格一下。關機還原原廠解碼器這點沒有另外確認。

en: First release on fpSup-Merge. Sensor Lab-IMX410 0.0.1test is SensorLab-IMX410 v0.7.39test renamed; the code is unchanged.

From the Quick Set: sensor crop (DC), resolution (RES), frame rate (FPS), readout recipe (RECIPE), FORMAT, the data rate (MB/s) and QR. The choice is applied as a camera mode, so recordings really use it, and it is applied again at start-up without opening MENU or QS.

The merge hint follows the recipe that is actually in effect: 2x2 binning such as OG 3K shows “2x2”, not “2x”; a recipe that scales with RWZM shows “RWZM”. The small line under RECIPE is shorter: no size suffix, RS to one decimal.

CPU x2 (horizontal 2:1 averaging on the camera CPU) was tested and left out: the CPU merges about 103 MB/s, OG 3K 25p needs 457 MB/s. For half width use ISP HBIN 1 (RWZM); a saved CPU x2 setting becomes ISP HBIN 1.
Needs QS-Share, which the page adds automatically. Cannot run together with RES-Custom (both change the recording modes); on one card RES-Custom loads and Sensor Lab is refused.
Updating: delete fpSup\SensorLab-IMX410_v0.7.*.BIN and fpSup\QSContainer_v*.BIN from the card first. Settings start from the defaults.
On the camera (as v0.7.39test, 2026-11-05): start-up apply, QS and RECIPE display, the CPU x2 setting moved to ISP HBIN 1.
zh: 第一次上 fpSup-Merge。Sensor Lab-IMX410 0.0.1test 就是改名的 SensorLab-IMX410 v0.7.39test，程式沒有改。
在快速設定選感光元件裁切（DC）、解析度（RES）、幀率（FPS）、讀取配方（RECIPE）、FORMAT，並顯示資料率（MB/s）與 QR。選擇會套用成相機的模式，錄影真的照它錄；開機時自動再套用，不用先開 MENU 或 QS。
合併提示改看實際生效的配方：OG 3K 這類 2x2 合併顯示「2x2」，不再誤顯示「2x」；有 RWZM 縮放的配方顯示「RWZM」。RECIPE 下方小字縮短：去掉尺寸尾巴，RS 改一位小數。
CPU×2（用相機 CPU 做水平 2:1 等權合併）實測後不納入：CPU 合併約 103 MB/s，OG 3K 25p 需要 457 MB/s。要水平減半請用 ISP HBIN 1（RWZM）；存過 CPU×2 的設定會自動改成 ISP HBIN 1。
需要 QS-Share，合併頁會自動附上。不能和 RES-Custom 同時執行（兩者都改錄影模式）；同一張卡上 RES-Custom 會先載入、Sensor Lab 被拒。
更新：先刪掉卡上 fpSup 裡的 SensorLab-IMX410_v0.7.*.BIN 與 QSContainer_v*.BIN。設定會回到預設。
已上機（以 v0.7.39test，2026-11-05）：開機自動套用、QS 與 RECIPE 顯示、舊 CPU×2 設定轉成 ISP HBIN 1。

en: Shared Quick Set plumbing used by Sensor Lab: adds its functions to the QS editor and the QS page. It is not a choice of its own; the page adds it with Sensor Lab.
QS-Share 0.0.1test is QS Container v0.3.8 renamed (same sup_id, QSCT). Delete fpSup\QSContainer_v*.BIN from the card: it is the same sup and only one of them loads.
Fixed: the name the camera shows for this sup (SupManager) was “font_menu_SB_kigou_09” since v0.2.1; it is now “QS-Share”.
zh: Sensor Lab 共用的快速設定底層：把功能加進 QS 編輯器與 QS 頁。它不是單獨的選項，勾 Sensor Lab 時合併頁自動附上。
QS-Share 0.0.1test 就是改名的 QS Container v0.3.8（sup_id 同為 QSCT）。請刪掉卡上 fpSup 裡的 QSContainer_v*.BIN：同一個 sup 只會載入一個。
修正：相機（SupManager）顯示的名稱自 v0.2.1 起誤為「font_menu_SB_kigou_09」，現在是「QS-Share」。

en: Fixes the RES-Custom files page: after paging to a last page with fewer rows and paging back, the earlier pages showed only their top row until the page was left and reopened. Reported, with the fix confirmed on his camera, by Ruari.
Nothing else changes; the format files (OG2K, OG3K, OG3.5K, OG4K, S16) are the same as 0.1.5's.
On the camera with Loader v4 (2026-11-12): 16 format files on four pages, paged to the last and back, every row shown. Recording and keeping the selection across power-off are still not tested.
zh: 修正 RES-Custom 檔案頁：翻到列數較少的最後一頁再翻回來，前面各頁只剩第一列，要離開再進來才恢復。由 Ruari 回報，並在他的相機上確認修法。
其他行為不變；格式檔（OG2K、OG3K、OG3.5K、OG4K、S16）與 0.1.5 相同。
Loader v4 上機（2026-11-12）：16 個格式檔共四頁，翻到最後一頁再翻回，每一列都顯示。錄影、關機後保留選擇仍未測。

en: Rebuilt for Loader v4: one file per sup, named with its version. Delete the whole old fpSup folder before updating the card.

Faster key presses on the fpSup, SupManager and RES-Custom pages are no longer dropped. SupManager shows each sup's version, e.g. “Gyro2 (0.2.1)”; with two versions of one sup on the card the newer one loads. Loader v3 sups do not load under v4. Sups that cannot run together are all installed; the one switched off can be switched on in SupManager on the camera.

The list of format files opens from the RES-CUSTOM row on the fpSup page. Each row is named as in the resolution list with its size, e.g. “OG3K (3008x2000)”, with the camera's own On / Off on the right; the title shows enabled / total, e.g. “RES-CUSTOM (5/6)”. A change that needs a restart shows “Unload on restart” / “Load on restart”.
The card file is renamed; the format files stay in \fpSup\RESCUS\. Formats unchanged: OG2K, OG3K, OG3.5K, OG4K, S16.
On the camera with Loader v4 so far: menus and page changes only; recording, and keeping the selection across power-off, not yet tested.
zh: 為 Loader v4 重建：一個 sup 一個檔，檔名帶版本。更新卡片前請先刪掉整個舊的 fpSup 資料夾。
fpSup 頁、SupManager、RES-Custom 頁快速連按不再掉鍵。SupManager 列名後面顯示版本，例如「Gyro2 (0.2.1)」;同一個 sup 新舊兩版都在卡上時自動載入新版。v3 格式的 sup 在 v4 不載入。合併頁上不相容的 sup 也都會裝進卡片，被關掉的那個可以在相機的 SupManager 打開。
格式檔案清單從 fpSup 頁的 RES-CUSTOM 列進入。每列名稱同解析度清單並加上尺寸，例如「OG3K (3008x2000)」,右欄用原廠的開啟／關閉;標題顯示啟用數／總數，例如「RES-CUSTOM (5/6)」。要重開才生效的改動會顯示「Unload on restart」／「Load on restart」。
卡上檔名改了,格式檔仍放在 \fpSup\RESCUS\。格式不變:OG2K、OG3K、OG3.5K、OG4K、S16。
Loader v4 上機目前只看過選單與換頁;錄影、選擇跨關機保留尚未上機測。

程式本體與已發行的 FCAP 逐位元組相同，只換成 Loader v4 檔頭。

en: First release.
Test build: the code ran on the camera as a development build; these exact files have not yet.
Loader v4: the same program under a v4 header; shown as “Unlock Writer”.
zh: 首次發布。
測試版：程式碼以開發版上機驗證過，這份檔案本身尚未上機。
Loader v4:程式本體相同，只換成 v4 檔頭;顯示名「Unlock Writer」。

en: Refines the lower-left FPS position, spacing, decimal digits and FPS label, with a thicker outward black edge around the white text.
Retains OG2K, OG3K, OG3.5K, OG4K and S16 with their existing bit-depth choices.
The first Quick Set opening after a restart is still slow.
zh: 調整左下角 FPS 的位置、大小數字間距、小數與 FPS 標示，白字的黑色描邊向外加厚。
保留 OG2K、OG3K、OG3.5K、OG4K、S16 及原有位深選項。
重開機後第一次開 QS 的等待問題仍未解決。

en: Uses much less of the camera’s processor while compressing.
Compressed frames keep their table in the DNG header; the header is 1 KB longer.
Long compressed takes rely on FCAP (ticked together on this page) instead of a batch-size change.
zh: 壓縮時佔用的相機處理器大幅減少。
壓縮畫格的表格改放在 DNG 檔頭內，檔頭多 1 KB。
長時間壓縮錄影改由 FCAP 處理(本頁勾選 Lossless 會一併勾上),不再調整批次大小。

en: OG3.5K and OG4K can now select 12-bit. The existing 8-bit and 10-bit options remain available.
Test release; recording with these exact files has not yet been checked on the camera.
zh: OG3.5K、OG4K 可選 12-bit，原有的 8-bit、10-bit 繼續保留。
測試版，這份檔案尚未在相機上實錄驗證。

en: First release: OG2K, OG3K, OG3.5K, OG4K and S16 are available together in one Sup.
Choose the recording resolution from the camera menu or Quick Set.
zh: 首次發布：一個 Sup 提供 OG2K、OG3K、OG3.5K、OG4K、S16 五種格式。
可從相機選單或 Quick Set 選擇錄影解析度。

en: Adds a fix by Ruari to help clear pending frames after an abnormal recording stop.
Use on its own or alongside Lossless. Test build.
zh: 新增 Ruari 的異常停錄修正，幫助相機清理暫存影格。
可單獨使用或搭配 Lossless。測試版。

en: Remembers the Lossless RAW setting after power-off.
Fixes FHD and OG2K recording stopping after about 94 frames.
Improves compression speed and reduces pauses when compression stalls.
zh: 關機後會記住 Lossless RAW 設定。
修正 FHD、OG2K 約錄到第 94 格就停止的問題。
改善壓縮速度，減少壓縮卡住時的等待。

en: Adds lossless-compressed CinemaDNG. Frames that cannot be compressed in time are saved uncompressed.
Works on the same card as RAW-View and starts faster. The setting resets to OFF at power-on.
zh: 加入無損壓縮 CinemaDNG；來不及壓縮的影格仍以未壓縮格式保存。
可與 RAW-View 同卡使用，開機更快。每次開機設定回到 OFF。

en: Records camera motion inside each CinemaDNG frame, without extra files or manual synchronisation.
Stabilise in Resolve with the Gyroflow (fpSup) plugin. Can be used with Lossless.
zh: 把相機晃動資料記在每格 CinemaDNG 裡，不需要額外檔案或手動同步。
可用 Resolve 的 Gyroflow（fpSup）插件防震，也能搭配 Lossless。

en: Saves RAW-View settings on the card, including SA / GA, contrast and saturation.
Without this card, the camera returns to its normal colour mode.
Preserves the full saturation setting.
zh: RAW-View 設定改存到卡片，包括 SA／GA、對比與飽和度。
移除這張卡後，相機回到正常色彩模式。
飽和度會保存完整設定值。

en: Can share a card with Lossless and OpenGate without replacing their menu entries.
Fixes the RAW row showing -5 / +5 instead of SA / GA when used with Lossless.
zh: 可與 Lossless、OpenGate 同卡使用，不會蓋掉彼此的選單項目。
修正搭配 Lossless 時，RAW 列顯示 -5／+5 而非 SA／GA 的問題。

en: Restores normal CinemaDNG playback brightness. RAW monitoring returns when you resume shooting.
zh: 修正 CinemaDNG 在相機上回放時亮度不正確的問題；回到拍攝時恢復 RAW 監看。

en: Remembers RAW mode, SA / GA, contrast and saturation after normal power-off.
Smaller files make it easier to combine with other Sups; improves the display near overexposure.
zh: 正常關機後會記住 RAW 模式、SA／GA、對比與飽和度。
檔案縮小，更容易與其他 Sup 合用；改善接近過曝處的顯示。

en: Adjusts SA brightness and changes contrast and saturation to 0 / +0.2 choices.
Crushed shadows appear black; the RAW row shows SA / GA.
zh: 調整 SA 的明暗表現，對比與飽和度改為 0／+0.2 兩種選項。
壓掉的暗部顯示純黑，RAW 列改顯示 SA／GA。

en: Adds RAW monitoring for 12-bit CinemaDNG, with SA and GA display options.
Makes screen clipping match the recorded image, with optional colour calibration.
zh: 加入 12-bit CinemaDNG 的 RAW 監看，提供 SA、GA 兩種顯示方式。
讓螢幕與錄下影像的過曝位置對應，並可套用色彩校正。

en: First release: rotate the screen 180°, mirror it, or use both.
Save separate settings for each STILL / CINE custom display mode; touch input follows 180° rotation.
zh: 首次發布：背螢幕可翻轉 180°、左右鏡像，或兩者同時使用。
STILL／CINE 的各自訂顯示模式分別保存設定，180° 時觸控也跟著旋轉。

en: v0.1.1test: works together with Tap to Zoom.
v0.1.2test: magnifier frame guides follow the selected squeeze factor.
v0.1.3test / v0.1.4test: corrects the vertical position of the frame guides.
zh: v0.1.1test：可與 Tap to Zoom 一起使用。
v0.1.2test：放大構圖框會跟著選擇的還原比例縮放。
v0.1.3test／v0.1.4test：修正構圖框的垂直位置。

en: First release: tap the LCD to magnify around that point.
Choose 2x, 4x or 8x with the dials; tap again to return to the full frame. Works during recording.
zh: 首次發布：輕觸 LCD，即以該點為中心放大。
轉盤可選 2x、4x、8x，再點一次恢復全畫面；錄影中也可使用。

en: Faster memory reading and writing over USB.
Fixes commands occasionally disappearing and improves startup speed.
Can be combined with other Sups on the same card.
zh: 透過 USB 讀寫記憶體更快。
修正指令偶爾遺失的問題，並改善開機速度。
可與其他 Sup 放在同一張卡。

en: Restores the camera after normal power-off, so changes do not carry into the next startup.
zh: 正常關機時還原相機，避免修改殘留到下次開機。

en: Improves memory sharing when several tools are used together.
Records when loading finishes.
zh: 改善多項工具同時使用時的記憶體分配。
記錄載入完成時間。

en: Can coexist with other tools on the same card.
Starts faster and retains support for existing commands.
zh: 可與其他工具在同一張卡共存。
開機更快，既有指令繼續支援。

en: Adds a USB development tool for sending camera commands and reading their replies.
zh: 加入 USB 開發工具，可向相機送出指令並讀回結果。

en: OG3.5K and OG4K can now select 12-bit. The existing 8-bit and 10-bit options remain available.
Test release; recording with these exact files has not yet been checked on the camera.
zh: OG3.5K、OG4K 可選 12-bit，原有的 8-bit、10-bit 繼續保留。
測試版，這份檔案尚未在相機上實錄驗證。

en: Reduces memory used by the Lossless menu.
Recording and playback behaviour remains the same as v0.1.2test.
zh: 減少 Lossless 選單占用的記憶體。
錄影與回放維持 v0.1.2test 的行為。

en: Fixes footage appearing cooler in Resolve when saturation is set to +0.2.
Saturation 0, RAW monitoring and recorded RAW pixels are unchanged.
zh: 修正飽和度設為 +0.2 時，影片在 Resolve 裡偏冷的問題。
飽和度 0、RAW 監看與錄下的 RAW 像素維持原樣。

en: Fixes the camera freezing while a Screen Flip value is being set or right after, and when switching into a display mode: the sup's task now has an 8 KiB stack (it was 4 KiB), enough for writing the setting to the card.
Nothing else changes; your saved flip settings are kept.
On the camera with Loader v4 (2026-11-11): 19 value changes with their saves and 25 STILL / CINE switches without a freeze; switching with the DISP button checked by hand.
zh: 修正設定 Screen Flip 的值時（或剛設完）、以及切進顯示模式時相機凍結的問題：sup 的任務堆疊由 4 KiB 加到 8 KiB，足夠把設定寫進卡片。
其他行為不變；已存的翻轉設定會保留。
Loader v4 上機（2026-11-11）：改值並存檔 19 次、STILL／CINE 切換 25 次都沒有凍結；DISP 鍵切換由手動確認。

en: First release. Put .cube files in fpSup\LUT\; in the fpSup page's LUT manager, set each one's input, then turn it on: the camera converts it once for its own colour hardware.
A LUT that is on is a tile in the native COLOR list, right after OFF. The look shows on the screen and is recorded into JPG and MOV; DNG and CinemaDNG stay RAW.
Up to 12 LUTs on at once, 32 in the folder. Needs COL-Share, which comes with it.
zh: 第一版。把 .cube 放進 fpSup\LUT\；在 fpSup 頁的 LUT manager 先設定每支的輸入，再開啟：相機會把它轉成自己色彩硬體的設定，只轉一次。
開啟的 LUT 會出現在原生 COLOR 清單、接在 OFF 後面。螢幕上看得到，JPG 與 MOV 也會套用；DNG 與 CinemaDNG 仍是 RAW。
最多同時開 12 支，資料夾最多 32 支。需要 COL-Share，會自動附上。

en: First release. Shared plumbing: it owns the rows LUT and RAW-View add to the native COLOR list, so both can be on one card.
zh: 第一版。共用元件：LUT 與 RAW-View 加進原生 COLOR 清單的列都由它管理，兩者可以裝在同一張卡。

en: RAW-View now hands its COLOR row to COL-Share instead of changing the list itself, so it works on the same card as LUT. COL-Share comes with it.
What it shows is unchanged.
zh: RAW-View 改成把它的 COLOR 列交給 COL-Share，不再自己改清單，所以能和 LUT 裝在同一張卡。COL-Share 會自動附上。
畫面顯示的內容不變。
